The formula for the derivative of arcsine is

$$
\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{arcsin}⁡x)=\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-{x}^{2}}}.
$$

Using the formula above, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(5+9\operatorname{arcsin}⁡x) \\  & =0+9\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{arcsin}⁡x) \\  & =0+9\cdot \frac{1}{\sqrt{1-{x}^{2}}} \\  & =\frac{9}{\sqrt{1-{x}^{2}}}.\end{aligned}
$$
